title: a Dear ImGui style

mistakes.what: ImVec4(0.23, 0.51, 0.96) for buttons, a stock blue
ImVec4(0.90, 0.91, 0.92) for borders, a grey off the ramp
ImVec4(0.61, 0.64, 0.69) for disabled text, a grey off the ramp

knownLimits: style.FrameRounding = 8.0f and style.WindowRounding = 4.0f (lines 7 and 8) are NOT expected to be read: they are struct fields, not properties the alias table maps to CSS, and only the ImVec4 colour literals are read. A radius finding there would be a bonus, not a requirement.
